description: A garment on an invisible mannequin from its photos (front, back, left, right, top, bottom and more angles, as files, URLs or assets), in the view asked (front, three_quarter, back), on a clean white studio background; instruction and metadata add factual product context. Results are saved to the output directory; long jobs come back as a generation_id for ideogram_generation; ideogram_quote prices a call first.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio with a colon — 1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 16:9 or 9:16 where the operation lists them (colorways and material swap default to the photo's ratio, ghost mannequin and sketch to render to 1:1, pose variants to the nearest supported); magic prompt: the ratio to pin, or omitted for the model's pick

back_image.description: The back-view garment photo (local file or public https URL); back_asset_identifier for an Ideogram asset

bottom_image.description: The bottom-view garment photo (local file or public https URL); bottom_asset_identifier for an Ideogram asset

front_image.description: The front-view garment photo (local file or public https URL); front_asset_identifier for an Ideogram asset

garment_asset_identifiers.description: Ideogram assets as more photos of the same garment, in order (at most 15)

garment_images.description: More photos of the same garment, local files or public https URLs (at most 15; several angles let obscured construction be reconstructed)

inline_images.description: true: each saved image is also returned as image content (base64; one over 3.75 MB, or past 10 MB in total, by path only), for a client without file access

instruction.description: Plain-language direction: the pose or camera for a pose variant, the materials and construction for a render, the reconstruction guidance for a ghost mannequin

left_image.description: The left-view garment photo (local file or public https URL); left_asset_identifier for an Ideogram asset

metadata.description: A JSON object serialized as a string with factual product context (title, brand, category, colour, material, item code)

private.description: Keep the result out of Ideogram's public feed; true unless you set false (enterprise accounts are always private)

quality.description: low, medium or high: higher may improve detail and takes longer

right_image.description: The right-view garment photo (local file or public https URL); right_asset_identifier for an Ideogram asset

seed.description: Random seed for a repeatable result

top_image.description: The top-view garment photo (local file or public https URL); top_asset_identifier for an Ideogram asset

view.description: The camera view of the output garment: front, three_quarter or back

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the result (0-50, default 45). The job is accepted first; if it is still running when the wait ends, the result is its generation_id for ideogram_generation (never resubmitted, never billed twice).

name: ideogram_ghost_mannequin
title: Ghost mannequin
